our_title: Sonar token expanded into sonar-project.properties, archived for 15 days with the -X scanner log
read_only: 7.0.18 ci/analysis.sh:28 'sonar.login=$SONARQUBE_LOGIN' inside the unquoted heredoc; .gitlab-ci.yml:129 '- sonar-scanner -X > sonar.log', artifacts paths 'sonar-project.properties' and './*.log' (expire_in 15 days). Patched .gitlab-ci.yml parses (python yaml).
why_not_run: needs the GitLab sonar runner and the secret; nothing to run locally
severity_note: Agrees with the review: a credential in a downloadable artifact; mitigated only by the schedule-only rule and the project's artifact permissions.
evidence: cat > sonar-project.properties << EOF\nsonar.host.url=https://sonarqube.inria.fr/sonarqube\nsonar.login=$SONARQUBE_LOGIN  /  script: - sonar-scanner -X > sonar.log ; artifacts: paths: - analyzer_reports - sonar-project.properties - ./*.log ... expire_in: 15 days
review_accuracy: Accurate. sonar.login is also deprecated (SonarQube 10) in favour of sonar.token / SONAR_TOKEN.
first_pass_critique: Right. Its preferred sketch exported SONAR_TOKEN in the script; the patch sets it with the job's variables: block (no shell line, no echo) and also stops archiving ./*.log, which its sketch kept.

fix_options.label: Token through SONAR_TOKEN, nothing archived
fix_options.summary: Drop sonar.login from the heredoc; variables: SONAR_TOKEN: $SONARQUBE_LOGIN; run sonar-scanner without -X and without redirection; archive neither the properties file nor logs.
fix_options.tested: YAML parsed with pyyaml (job keys as intended); no scanner run.
fix_options.tradeoffs: Needs a SonarScanner CLI that reads SONAR_TOKEN (4.7+); output goes to the job trace, which GitLab masks; -X debug output lost (re-add it when debugging, it stays in the trace).
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Smallest change that removes the secret from disk and artifacts; same shape as his CI edits (variables blocks per job).

fix_options.label: -Dsonar.token on the command line
fix_options.summary: sonar-scanner -Dsonar.token="$SONARQUBE_LOGIN"; drop the file and logs from artifacts.
fix_options.tested: untested
fix_options.tradeoffs: Works with any scanner version, but the token is visible in the runner's process list.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Acceptable fallback if the runner's scanner is older than 4.7.

fix_options.label: Keep the file, stop archiving it
fix_options.summary: Leave analysis.sh; remove sonar-project.properties and ./*.log from artifacts; drop -X.
fix_options.tested: untested
fix_options.tradeoffs: Token still written to the runner workspace; one artifacts glob away from leaking again.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Half a fix.

cleanup_done: removed the sonar.log redirection and the two artifact paths that carried the secret
